observations: Predicted no unseen sentence from a one-word successor model trained on three explicit cat/dog sentences.

Manually chose dog,sat,on,the,mat; result 'the dog sat on the mat.' marked New, with all six pair counts listed. Restarted and auto-finished repetitive 'the cat sat on the cat sat on the cat sat on the dog sat on the mat.', also New.
Reveal recalls first novel sentence and explains local pair recombination, possible nonsense, and longer context used by larger language models.
1280x720 light screenshots: sentence and pair chips clear, reveal prose clipped at right edge.
